title: Snake lemma in an abelian category (Stacks 010H)
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], with exactness as in [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Let $$\begin{array}{ccccccc}A_1&\xrightarrow{f}&A_2&\xrightarrow{g}&A_3&\to&0\\ \downarrow\alpha&&\downarrow\beta&&\downarrow\gamma&&\\ 0\to B_1&\xrightarrow{k}&B_2&\xrightarrow{l}&B_3&&\end{array}$$ be a commutative diagram of $\mathcal A$ ($\beta f=k\alpha$, $\gamma g=l\beta$) whose rows are exact: $A_1\to A_2\to A_3$ is exact at $A_2$ and $g$ is an epimorphism, $B_1\to B_2\to B_3$ is exact at $B_2$ and $k$ is a monomorphism. Let $\operatorname{Ker}\alpha,\operatorname{Ker}\beta,\operatorname{Ker}\gamma$ and $\operatorname{Coker}\alpha,\operatorname{Coker}\beta,\operatorname{Coker}\gamma$ be kernels and cokernels in $\mathcal A$, let $f':\operatorname{Ker}\alpha\to\operatorname{Ker}\beta$, $g':\operatorname{Ker}\beta\to\operatorname{Ker}\gamma$ be the morphisms induced by $f,g$ and $k':\operatorname{Coker}\alpha\to\operatorname{Coker}\beta$, $l':\operatorname{Coker}\beta\to\operatorname{Coker}\gamma$ those induced by $k,l$. Then there is a morphism $\partial:\operatorname{Ker}\gamma\to\operatorname{Coker}\alpha$ such that the sequence $$\operatorname{Ker}\alpha\xrightarrow{f'}\operatorname{Ker}\beta\xrightarrow{g'}\operatorname{Ker}\gamma\xrightarrow{\partial}\operatorname{Coker}\alpha\xrightarrow{k'}\operatorname{Coker}\beta\xrightarrow{l'}\operatorname{Coker}\gamma$$ is exact. If moreover $f$ is a monomorphism then $f'$ is a monomorphism, and if $l$ is an epimorphism then $l'$ is an epimorphism.
